name: Reflect a speaker's key point
short_description: Restate one speaker's main point and check whether the restatement is accurate.
self_assessment: I can reflect one speaker's key point without help and ask whether I captured it.
description: Restate one speaker's main point and check whether the restatement is accurate. The stated threshold defines a repeatable capability that can be demonstrated in a fresh but ordinary context. It covers preparation, execution, and checking the result within the named conditions. It excludes a one-off task or dependence on a particular product, institution, culture, or living arrangement, so the holder can assess and retain it as a transferable skill.
